## Looking for full transcript of video?Read now


Join Brian as he introduces the innovative SHOWA 709HVO and 709B single-use gloves. Learn about the new PyraGrip Technology, a unique texture on both sides of the glove that channels away oils and fluids for a safer, more secure grip. Whether you're working with grease or need a high-visibility option, Brian explains why these durable, ambidextrous gloves are a game-changer for hand protection.


***This video was previously featured on SHOWA's***[YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xqDfBk6vBCk) ***.***
